priorities.name: Quiet, private space for meeting-heavy and technical work
priorities.issue: Managers spend the day in back-to-back calls with nowhere private to take them, and the shift to smaller, clustered cubes has made focused technical work harder.
whatItLooksLike: no privacy with ongoing all day meetings and calls
The change from professional cubes to much smaller, highly clustered cubes make it very difficult to focus on technical work.

evidence.text: Focused / Private Work is the #1 priority category (80/100); focused-space friction 34/100 (61% under-supported).
Noise & Distraction: 137 comments (64% neg); Privacy & Confidentiality: 124 comments (60% neg); Focus/Concentration: 96 (55%).

priorities.proposedAction: Assess enclosed/manager-suitable space and the cube-density change against demand; validate whether zoning or added enclosed rooms is warranted before build-out.
priorities.siteMustDo: Walk the floor at peak, quantify where private space runs out, and bring a sized gap (including the cube-density concern) to Workplace Solutions.

priorities.name: Manager workstations with monitors and a door
priorities.issue: Enclosed workstations equipped with monitors are scarce for managers who need them, and desk equipment is unreliable.
whatItLooksLike: The availability of workspaces with monitors and a door is limited for managers.
The limited areas to work when you have meetings that others should not hear. Not always able to sit in the same seat.

evidence.text: Hardware: 115 comments, 56% negative; Technology priority score 56/100.

priorities.proposedAction: Map demand for enclosed, monitor-equipped workstations and standardize desk equipment/checks.
priorities.siteMustDo: Quantify how many enclosed monitor-equipped seats are needed vs. available and route to Workplace Solutions.

priorities.name: Connectivity reliability
priorities.issue: Connectivity is a frequent and highly negative complaint.
whatItLooksLike: Connectivity is the most-negative technology theme at the site (see comment appendix).
priorities.proposedAction: Validate coverage/reliability in the reported areas and route to Technology.
priorities.siteMustDo: Log dead spots and times and escalate to Technology with locations.
